body:
New shared css/wotan-theme.css (violet/black background, violet primary, gold IDUNA-undertone secondary accent, Space Grotesk display font) applied to index.html, decks.html, store.html, profile.html, friends.html in place of each page's own copy-pasted :root/base style block. decks.html's existing Offense/Operations/Defense card coloring rides the same CSS variables unchanged (JS referenced by name/class, never hardcoded hex). Dropped light-mode support deliberately -- neon-brutalist is dark-only. Fixed a real bug found during centralization: store.html emits bare class="badge" with no modifier for Owned/Equipped, which the new shared unstyled-by-default .badge base would have rendered colorless -- added a page-local override. Verified with real headless (Playwright/Chromium) screenshots of all 5 pages served locally before shipping. Commit pending push in WOTAN repo.

⚓ ☃
title: Full visual redesign shipped -- BRAWLPIT neon-brutalist art direction across all 5 live pages
